name: The Salt Wren
lore: A salt trader running for Aldhollow ahead of the autumn gales. Her captain swears she has outsailed the serpent twice.

name: The Coiled One
lore: Rach fishermen count its coils to read the weather: three above the water means a storm by nightfall.

name: Old Greyback
lore: A whale older than the Council of Thirteen. Sailors tip a cup of ale over the side whenever her tail rises.

name: Wreck of the Merrow's Bell
lore: She went down with a hold full of temple bells. On still nights the divers say one of them still rings.

name: The Ferryman's Skiff
lore: A lone rower who takes no coin, only a story. Nobody on the Prazn shore will say where the skiff goes.

name: A Message in a Bottle
lore: The note inside is addressed to "whoever finds the edge of the map", and signed with your name.

name: The Nine Dancers
lore: A ring of standing stones on the Pynchas plain. No two travellers have ever counted the same number.

name: Hask's Watch
lore: A watchtower with no garrison and no key to its door. Someone still lights the lamp every seventh night.

name: The Oathstone
lore: Its runes name a king no chronicle remembers, and the moss of the Oshta shore will not grow over them.

name: A Stranger's Fire
lore: Still warm. Whoever sat here left in a hurry and took the kettle, but not the stew.

name: The Cartographer's Tent
lore: Whoever drew this map slept here. The ink pots are still full and the last page is blank.

name: A Young Wyrm
lore: Too small to be feared and too curious to keep away from the smoke of Kalyunbar.
